evidence.curator_note: Equation 8.37, line 2 of 3: 'OE+.  A(+)BCD  --sigma-->  A. + B=C(+)D'. Unlike line 1 (simple homolysis to a saturated carbenium), this branch expels a radical A. AND forms a NEW double bond B=C in the product, with the '+' drawn ON the doubly-bonded atom C. ARC COUNT (convention D): the book draws 0 curved arrows/fishhooks - a straight sigma-labelled net reaction arrow only. The 3 encoded electron_moves are IMPLICIT (reconstructed for balance, not drawn) and constitute a canonical radical-site alpha-cleavage (convention A, three fishhooks): move <1> the radical-site odd electron on the heteroatom (map 3) forms the new B=C pi bond (bond 2-3); move <2> one electron of the cleaving A-B sigma bond (bond 1-2) also enters that forming pi bond (bond 2-3); move <3> the other electron of the A-B sigma bond goes to the departing radical A (atom 1). MASS-BALANCE FINDING (why this is not a pure hydrocarbon): a saturated alkane radical cation CnH(2n+2)+. undergoing a SINGLE sigma-bond homolysis can only give a SATURATED carbenium CpH(2p+1)+ - forming a C=C double-bond cation CpH(2p-1)+ would require losing two extra H. So line 2, drawn as a saturated linear A-B-C-D chain yet producing a double-bond cation B=C(+)D, cannot be a pure C/H species; the '+' localized on a doubly-bonded atom is the signature of an oxo-/imino-carbenium (or acylium). INSTANTIATION (convention F): instantiated as the classic alpha-cleavage of the DIETHYL ETHER radical cation, mapping A=CH3 (map 1, leaves as .CH3), B=CH2 (map 2), C=O (map 3, the heteroatom that bears the '+' -> ethyl oxocarbenium CH2=O(+)-CH2CH3), D=OCH2CH3's ethyl (maps 4,5). This reproduces the drawn graph A-B-C-D and 'A. + B=C(+)D' exactly and is mass-balanced (C4H10O+. -> .CH3 + C3H7O+). Curator-computed detected ion m/z 59.0491 (C3H7O+); derives from this instantiation, NOT from the page (the page prints no m/z or intensity). LOCALIZATION note (conventions B/C): for an ether the radical cation physically localizes +/. on oxygen (n-ionization), so the precursor SMILES places them on O (map 3); the generic scheme instead draws the '+' on the A-B sigma region, a schematic delocalized picture. No resonance ambiguity in the product oxocarbenium.

NO MOD rule is indexed for Equation 8.37 (rule_index.json 'by_equation' stops at 8.14; no 8.37 key). No cross-link is asserted. The encoded step is a heteroatom alpha-cleavage forming an oxocarbenium; MOD's chapter-8 rules (IMS_8_*) do include alpha/inductive fragmentations but none is keyed to 8.37, and the diethyl-ether instantiation here is a curator choice made to satisfy mass balance for the generic line-2 scheme rather than a book-named substrate. m/z 59.0491 (C3H7O+) is curator-computed from the diethyl-ether instantiation.
